summary.zh: 把个人记忆、设计调研、画布检查和周期委托放进同一工作流。
summary.en: Brings personal memory, design research, canvas checks and recurring briefs into one workflow.

use.zh: 试一个有明确品牌要求的重复项目，看第二次还需解释多少。
use.en: Try a repeated brief with explicit brand requirements; see how much needs explaining again.

note.zh: APPSO 的体验报告；持续委托先核对预算、版本与人工复核节点。
note.en: Reported by APPSO. Check task budgets, versions and review points before recurring work.

summary.zh: Pi Durable 的社区探索：把持久任务接入 Swift 与 Apple 框架。
summary.en: A community Pi Durable experiment connecting durable tasks to Swift and Apple frameworks.

use.zh: 看原帖的天气、音乐与语音交互，观察原生设备能力怎样进入 Agent。
use.en: Explore the post’s weather, music and voice interactions as examples of native integrations.

note.zh: 收藏时仍未开源；不是 Pi 的正式通用客户端，恢复能力未独立复测。
note.en: Not open source when saved; not an official general Pi client. Recovery was not independently tested.

summary.zh: 提取渲染后的网页内容，尽量保住表格、视觉符号与页面信息的关系。
summary.en: Extracts rendered pages while aiming to preserve tables, visual cues and their meaning.

use.zh: 拿带勾叉的套餐表试一遍，检查模型有没有读反功能归属。
use.en: Try a pricing table with checkmarks and crosses; inspect which plan gets each feature.

note.zh: 官网效果与基准为厂商披露；重要字段仍要回到原页核对。
note.en: Vendor-reported results. Check consequential fields against the original page.

summary.zh: 带时间和来源的记忆检索，关注事实更新以后，旧值怎样被替换。
summary.en: Memory retrieval with dates and sources, emphasizing how changed facts replace old values.

use.zh: 给同一笔预算录入两次变更，检查返回值和引用是否同步更新。
use.en: Record two budget changes; check that the retrieved value and source change together.

note.zh: 适合检验记忆的时效性；不把官网演示分数当作你的任务准确率。
note.en: Useful for probing freshness. A demo score is not your application’s accuracy.

summary.zh: 把声音转成描述、时间线与测量结果，让编程 Agent 获得音频反馈。
summary.en: Turns sound into descriptions, timelines and measurements a coding agent can inspect.

use.zh: 让它检查视频的音效落点，再亲耳听一遍修改前后的差别。
use.en: Inspect where a video’s effects land, then listen to the before-and-after yourself.

note.zh: 项目提供本地 CPU、CLI 与 MCP 路径；评分不能代替听感判断。
note.en: Offers local CPU, CLI and MCP use. Scores do not replace listening.

summary.zh: 让不同电脑与工具里的编程 Agent 互相提问、交接明确的小任务。
summary.en: Lets coding agents across machines and tools ask each other questions and hand over bounded tasks.

use.zh: 先试一次有具体输入和答案的跨项目咨询，观察是否减少人的转述。
use.en: Start with one concrete cross-project question; see whether it removes human relaying.

note.zh: 通信通道不等于质量保证；共享范围、权限和结果复核仍需明确。
note.en: A communication channel does not ensure quality. Define data access and result checks.

summary.zh: 用应用限时和主动屏蔽，减少无意识刷手机的时间。
summary.en: Uses app limits and deliberate blocking to interrupt habitual scrolling.

use.zh: 给最容易随手打开的一个 App 设边界，给自己留一段完整时间。
use.en: Set a boundary for one reflexively opened app and protect an uninterrupted stretch.

note.zh: 来自 DEX #368；这是注意力工具，不是 AI 产品。
note.en: From DEX #368. An attention tool, not an AI product.

summary.zh: 把评论钉在原型的具体元素上，再把反馈交给开发流程。
summary.en: Pins comments to specific prototype elements and passes feedback into implementation.

use.zh: 用一轮真实改稿，检查「这里」是否变成了准确的元素与修改要求。
use.en: Use a real revision round: does “here” become an exact element and a clear request?

note.zh: DEX 收录的产品；接入 Slack 或 Agent 前先确认共享对象。
note.en: A DEX product lead. Check who receives feedback before connecting Slack or agents.

summary.zh: 问答收敛任务，设计一个 Bot
summary.en: Narrow a job and design a bot

summary.zh: 把散落的承诺变成待办并跟进
找出旧规则与重复指令
跟踪竞品网站与产品变化
整理材料并制作解说视频
把书签整理成读、做、删的选择
summary.en: Turn bookmarks into read, act or delete

summary.zh: 汇总 AI 动态并附原始链接
summary.en: Collect AI updates with original links

summary.zh: 分配开发任务并追踪检查
先看方案、批注，再开始制作
